# DESIGN:OS Robotics (`design-os-robotics`)

> Agentic firmware toolchain, 244 KB procedural-21 vector face, and 60 fps spring-reflex soul engine for ESP32-S3 voice robots.

DESIGN:OS Robotics is a source-available, local-first hardware control, `esp_mmap_assets` theme compiler, 4-layer non-intrusive diagnostic dashboard, and Spec-Driven Generative AI Tamagotchi runtime (`Project Mochi-Soul`) built for `RB5320XZ78AI` / `XiaoZhi78` (`ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U-N16R8`, `ST7789` 2.8" `240x320` IPS TFT, `MAX98357A + PCM5102A` dual DACs, `INMP441` MEMS microphone).

## Core Specifications & Measured Benchmarks

- **Target Hardware (`RB5320XZ78AI` / `RoBot.5320`)**: `ESP32-S3 N16R8` (240 MHz dual-core Xtensa LX7, 16 MB Quad-SPI Flash, 8 MB Octal PSRAM), `ST7789` `240x320` TFT (`SPI2` 40 MHz), `MAX98357A` I2S speaker amp + `PCM5102A` stereo line-out, `INMP441` I2S mic, `GPIO 17` battery ADC, `GPIO 38` charge detect, `GPIO 48` WS2812 RGB LED.
- **Spec 01 — Procedural Mochi-21 Vector Avatar (`tools/cook-procedural-avatar.py`)**: Generates all 21 distinct Mochi emotions + `robot_2` (`240x240` px, 16 frames, locked 12-color Indexed LZW palette) from 582 lines of geometric math in `244.71 KB` total (`-90.4%` vs `2,560.27 KB` factory GIFs; checksum `0x5867`).
- **Spec 02 — Mochi-Soul 4D Homeostasis Engine (`tools/mochi-soul-engine/engine.py`)**: Simulates continuous biological state $S(t) = [E, V, B, C]^T \in [0, 100]^4$ (`Energy`, `Valence`, `Bond`, `Curiosity`) across 4 evolution stages (`Mochi Spore`, `Curious Mochi`, `Companion Mochi`, `Cyber-Savant Mochi`) with SQLite WAL persistence (`~0.75 us/tick` measured idle, `1,306,786 ticks/s` (single run), `~4.0 us/tx` median of 12 runs, `21/21` emotions triggered, `0` Quiet Hours violations in the benchmark; Quiet Hours are `23:00–07:30`).
- **Spec 03 — Xiaozhi Proactive Bridge & HUD Card (`tools/mochi-soul-engine/bridge.py`)**: Matches `100%` of the disassembled `Application::OnIncomingJson` (`0x4202c0c8..0x4202c711` on `ota_1`) protocol (`notify`, `alert`, `llm`, `tts`, `mcp` JSON-RPC 2.0 `tools/call`) with `0.51 ms` HTTP loopback RTT and `1.22 ms` `240x320` HUD PNG card rendering (`2,716 B`).
- **Spec 04 — 60fps Second-Order Spring Reflex & Lip-Sync (`tools/mochi-soul-engine/reflex_60fps.py` & `mochi_face_60fps.hpp`)**: Solves $\ddot{\mathbf{x}} + 2\zeta\omega_n\dot{\mathbf{x}} + \omega_n^2(\mathbf{x} - \mathbf{x}_{\text{target}}) = 0$ across a 10-DOF vector (`2.36 us/frame` at 60Hz = `0.014%` frame budget, `420/420` emotion pair transitions converged, `6.77%` overshoot, lip-sync Pearson correlation $r = 0.9592$, `alignas(64)` C++17 header `3,898 B` zero-heap).
- **Zero-Reset 4-Layer Health Dashboard (`tools/robotctl.py`)**: Opens USB-JTAG with `~HUPCL` so `DTR/RTS` never resets the ESP32-S3 during active voice conversations.
